markdown:
# Plan tier mix shift

## Description

Emails a monthly digest of how revenue and customers spread across subscription plans, and whether the revenue mix is drifting up market or down market.

## Steps

### Step 1: Email the monthly plan mix digest

Build an automation that runs on the 1st of every month at 08:00 on a schedule. Each run it gives each user the plan of their latest plan; a subscription is active when no subscription canceled event or subscription expired event came after it for the same subscription id. It writes these figures per plan for the last 30 days, for each 30 days over the last 12 mo, and for the same 30 days a year ago: recurring revenue, the sum of amount with revenue type equal to recurring, and its share %; active customers and their share %; the change in each share in percentage points against a year ago; the number of upgrades and of downgrades per plan: a subscription started event whose plan is higher, or lower, than the same user's previous one. Then it emails these figures as plain-text lines, each with its window, to the email addresses that get the digest. The email names any plan whose revenue share moved more than 5 points, and any plan whose revenue share and customer share moved in opposite directions. Nothing else is sent.
